body_html:
Tsharre is a ball of excitement from North Carolina and she loves
making sure others are having a good time. Although most of my DJ experience is curating playlists for parties I practice and plan so that I can make sure your event has immaculate energy (insert chef’s kiss motion) by creating a great atmosphere. I am willing to go the
extra mile to make sure you all have the ride of your life, [are] y’all ready for a good time?! What attracted you to DJing?  The main thing that attracted me to DJ’ing is just the role the DJ plays in a social setting where one is present, besides the audience, they are the person that is responsible for ensuring everyone is having a good
time by keeping the music going and keeping the crowd excited with their commentary! What is the best part about being a  DJ?: I enjoy feeling care-free and although a lot of care and attention is required to run an event well, the joy of
seeing folks enjoy themselves and be carefree while I’m helping to shape that atmosphere is amazing. I also love
music, and being able to curate a sonically pleasing experience allows me to relax and really be present in that
moment where nothing matters but the crowd having a great time! What is in your headphones?   Top 40 (Pop/Today’s Hits), R&B,
and Country (mainstream) are my main genres in rotation, but my library is filled with Afro-pop to Worldwide, with a
little of everything in between.
